newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes slightly up against US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes slightly up against US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up slightly at 8.2962 against the U.S. dollar on Wednesday from Tuesday's 8.2963 on strong pro-yuan market sentiment, traders said.
The yuan opened down at an intra-day low of 8.2965 and moved between 8.2960 and 8.2964 for most of the session, hitting a high of 8.2938.
Trading was active, with most done at 8.2962, traders said.
Dealers said the yuan stayed in a narrow range below 8.2960 today, supported by bids at around 8.2970.
"Increasing buying gradually raised the yuan's floor level, which forced it to move in an increasingly narrow range," one dealer said.
The yuan's upward movement in recent months has been consistently capped by central bank intervention.
A second dealer said he expected the yuan to close above 8.2960 on Thursday.
The yuan closed higher at 7.0779 from 7.1000 against 100 Japanese yen and slightly down at 1.0724 from 1.0722 against the Hong Kong dollar.
